author: Zintenka
body:
Want your map to be great? Want your map to be awesome and unique?

Well then, here are some filters that can help ya!

How to add filters:
Open MCEdit folder and go to "Filters" folder and simply drag any downloaded filters. They are .py files which stands for python, the source code that MCEdit uses. Then go ingame and MCEdit will automatically turn them into .pyo and .pyc files. 

Villager Trades
These don't work in protected but you can substitute this with bedrock. This is great if you wanna add some uniqueness to your map. Made a map that is castle-based? Add a marketplace close but not at spawn. This can work in tune with many other 

Instructions:
You need to add a chest and fill it according to the organization below, items needed to trade. First and second rows. Item you want to trade to get: Last row. You can fill all the columns inside the chest. The end of trades blocks are not needed but are more for aesthetic and organization.

After you are done with this, go to MCEdit and select your chest. NOTE If you have multiple then DO NOT select them all at once as it WILL crash your game. Go to "Filters" then select "CreateShops" and choose what villager you want. Then chose invincibility if you wish (Optional but recommended). Do not select "Unlimited trades" for self-explanatory reasons. DO NOT select "End of Trades". Will put a piston head into trade and IT WILL CRASH YOUR GAME.

Roleplay:
Say you want TNT from this guy...


But he wants iron ingots in return...


Hell he might also want zombie eggs because he is suicidal..


You can use any unobtainable block as a marker for an end to a trade. Bedrock or a portal block are good ones.


So you trade it with him and you get the TNT. Boy, what a cheap bast-I mean... uh good salesman.. heheheh... yeah. 
Anyway, this is just an example and you can trade with most things. It is good to be creative but not too creative, a sense of balance must be achieved to make a good map. If you have OP items inside the shop then that is not good.

Got it? Good.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Item Attributes: 
http://www.mediafire.com/view/nm1e09ejg156w6t/CPAttributes.py

Give items special attributes to make 'em special. Give attack power to a chestplate. Hold it in your hand to wack someone to death with it or wear it to cause someone actual damage with your fists. 

Wearing it can also add damage points to held weapons. So if you are holding a diamond sword in your hand and you have a chestplate that gives you +8 damage then you WILL cause +15 damage which is extremely OP, add +1 or decimal based attack damage to make it balanced.

OP Leather Chesplate (Example on what not to make)

Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dGKP3BjAkTc

Spawners:
Self-explanatory! Go to various youtube videos to see tutorials to do this. I recommend SethBling as he has a plethora of tutorials.

Extra Filters:
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/addpotioneffect/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/changemobs/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/creategearedmobs/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/editbeacons/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/enchant/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/mobattribute/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/mobgear/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/modifyitemstrings/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/modifypotions/
http://sethbling.com/downloads/mcedit-filters/playerskulls/

Remember, map making isnt just about helping the server. Its also about learning new things and having fun. We all want Avicus to grow and map quality to be sufficiently higher. 

Let's make it happen.
